name: LValueData.inner_trivialLift_self_eq_L
summary: Doubling: ⟨Ξ, Ξ⟩ is a doubling integral of the constant function on U(1); its partial integrals off the places of X are computed place by place (local doubling integrals give the Euler factors of L^{S∪S̄}(k, BC μ⁻¹)/ζ-type factors), the archimedean part by the Fock pairing of the highest vector (hookNumber), and the finite part at the places of X by the sharp datum (indices of parabolic and vector stabilizers).

steps.claim: Not a step of the proof: lines 192–195 are the rest of the statement, which ends before the `:=` on line 195 (a second-reader message). The line census takes the `:=` of `let C :=` on line 192 for the start of the value, so the check requires these lines to be owned here. They state: C = vol([U(I_n)])·vol([U(I₁)]) / eulerProd(realZetaCoeff, |n|/2); C ≠ 0 and ⟨trivialLift(X), trivialLift(X)⟩ = C·∏_i(q(chosenPlace(X, i)) − 1)·hookNumber(κ(auxPair(X)), rankAt(n))·#WeylIndex(n, κ(auxPair(X)))·L(μ(X)⁻¹, places(X), k)·(∏_i q(twistPlace(X, i)))^{|n|−1}.
steps.lean:
let C := (stdSpace E n).quotMeasure.real ⊤ * (stdSpace E Unit).quotMeasure.real ⊤ / eulerProd
      (K := E) realZetaCoeff (card n / 2 :); C ≠ 0 ∧ inner ℂ X.trivialLift X.trivialLift =
      C * (∏ i, ((X.chosenPlace i).q - 1) :) * hookNumber X.auxPair.κ (rankAt n) * card (WeylIndex n
      X.auxPair.κ) * X.μ⁻¹.L X.places k * (∏ i, (X.twistPlace i).q :) ^ (card n - 1) := by

steps.claim: Write O for the auxiliary pair auxPair(X) (W = I₁, V = I_n).
steps.lean: let O := X.auxPair

steps.claim: At every finite place w: the index in GL_n(k_w) of the group rangeParabolic(incl(O)) equals that of the parabolic fixing the line of the embedded basis vector, which is ∑_{j<|n|} q_w^j (`index_rangeParabolic`, `index_stabilizer_line`); and the index of the stabilizer of the column of the inclusion matrix (a non-zero vector) is q_w^{|n|} − 1 (`index_stabilizer_GL_vector`).
steps.lean:
have G (w : FinPlace E) := And.intro
    ((index_rangeParabolic (R := ResField w) O.incl).trans (index_stabilizer_line (O.incl ())
    fun _ ↦ forall_congr' (by grind [lt_iff_le_not_ge, le_Prop_eq]))) ((congrArg _ (ext fun _ ↦
    funext_iff.trans Unique.forall_iff : stabilizer (GL n (ResField w)) (inclMatrix (ResField w)
    O.incl).col = _)).trans (index_stabilizer_GL_vector (by simp [inclMatrix, funext_iff])))

steps.claim: From `AuxPair.levelIndicator_support_and_normSq` for O: the support property f and the norm c of F = #TwistGL(O, 1)·levelIndicator(O); further |realZetaCoeff(w)| ≤ 1 at every finite place w and k > 1 as a real number; and k = |n|/2 (from hM).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨⟨f, c⟩, ⟨A, B⟩, ⟨⟩⟩ := O.levelIndicator_support_and_normSq, (by simpa [realZetaCoeff,
    apply_ite] : (∀ w : FinPlace E, ‖realZetaCoeff w‖ ≤ 1) ∧ 1 < (k : ℝ)), (by lia : k = card n / 2)

steps.claim: Let S be the finite set of the places of X (chosen and twist places) together with their conjugates, listed by an injective map (the places are pairwise apart, `LevelPlaces.apart`).
steps.lean:
let S := univ.map ⟨_ ∘ X.placeAt ⊕ᵥ X.placeAt,
    (star_injective.comp X.apart.1).sumElim X.apart.1 X.apart.2⟩

steps.claim: Let D be the conjugate closure of the set of places of X.
steps.lean: let D := X.places.conjClosure

steps.claim: For every finite place w: w ∈ S if and only if w ∈ D.
steps.lean: have a w : w ∈ S ↔ w ∈ D := by simp [S, D]; grind [star_star]

steps.claim: The constant function 1 on U(I₁) is automorphic and rapidly decreasing (`Space.isAutomorphic_const`, `Space.IsAutomorphic.mem_rapidFunctions`; I₁ is definite); and the datum F ⊗ vac on Hom(I₁, I_n) is sharp for the character b(O) and the principal level at the places of 𝔪 = levelModulus(X, 1) and their conjugates (`isSharp_modDatum`), the tame part of μ being 1 off the places of X (`LValueData.unramified`).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨o, U⟩ := ((stdSpace E Unit).isAutomorphic_const 1).mem_rapidFunctions,
    places_levelModulus (S := X.1) (c := 1) ▸ isSharp_modDatum (stdSpace
    ..) O.b (by simp) _ f (by simp_all [unramified, O]) (by simp [↓c, NeZero.ne])

steps.claim: The Euler products converge at k > 1 (`hasProd_eulerProd`, the Hecke coefficients off D being bounded by 1, `IsHeckeOfType.norm_heckeCoeff_le`): the product over the finite places w of (1 − realZetaCoeff(w)q_w^{−k})/(1 − heckeCoeff(μ⁻¹, D, w)q_w^{−k}) converges to the quotient of the partial L-value L(μ⁻¹, D, k) by eulerProd(realZetaCoeff, k); the quotient is defined because the Euler products are non-zero (`eulerProd_eq_exp`).
steps.lean:
have p := by simpa [heckeCoeff, Set.indicator, cpow_neg, ← HeckeChar.atUnif.eq_1] using
    (hasProd_eulerProd (X.hasWeight.inv.isHeckeOfType.norm_heckeCoeff_le (S := D)) B).div₀
                 (hasProd_eulerProd A B) (by simp [eulerProd_eq_exp, *])

steps.claim: The doubling inner product formula (`inner_product_formula`; rank condition 2·1 < |n|) for the constant function on U(I₁) (rapid by step 8) and the clean datum of the harmonic polynomial of the highest vector: the integrand g ↦ weilMatrixCoeff·petersson(1, R(g)1) is integrable (i), and ⟨lift, lift⟩ = vol[U(I_n)]·∫ of it (P). Moreover the Fock pairing of the polynomial of the highest vector with itself is hookNumber(κ(O), rankAt(n)) (`fockPairing_toPoly_toPoly`, `gramForm_highestVector_self`) (F).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨⟨i, P⟩, F⟩ := inner_product_formula (hM ▸ by simpa) O.a O.b (U.clean (O.harmonicPoly
    (highestVector _ O.paramV))) o o, (fockPairing_toPoly_toPoly (conj ∘ highestVector O.κ _)
    _).trans (congrArg _ (gramForm_highestVector_self (O.isHCParam_paramV ·|>.1)))

steps.claim: For a finite set R of finite places let T(R) = S ∪ R̄ ∪ R.
steps.lean: let T R := S ∪ R.image star ∪ R

steps.claim: Uniqueness of limits (`tendsto_nhds_unique_of_frequently_eq`) for R ↦ (∏_{w∈R} of the factors of step 9)·partialIntegral(R \ D) of the integrand of step 10: it converges to (the quotient of step 9)·partialIntegral(Dᶜ) (`tendsto_partialIntegral`, by (i)), and it is frequently equal to a constant, namely at the sets T(R), where its value is shown, by induction on R (`Finset.induction`), to be independent of R; the case R = ∅ is computed by unfolding partialIntegral and the local levels, and the inductive step is what follows. This gives the identity Q.
steps.lean:
have Q := tendsto_nhds_unique_of_frequently_eq (.mul p (tendsto_partialIntegral D i))
    tendsto_const_nhds (Filter.frequently_atTop.2 fun R ↦ ⟨T R, le_sup_right, R.induction (by
    simp [-prod_mul_distrib, T, a, partialIntegral, localLevel]; rw [prod_map, prod_sum_type]) fun w
    R _ ↦ .trans ?_⟩)

steps.claim: Inductive step, adding a place w to R: split on whether w lies in T(R). If it does, T(insert w R) = T(R) (shown in step 18) and the value is unchanged; the case w ∉ T(R) is treated next.
steps.lean: by_cases e : w ∈ T R; rw [(?_ : T _ = T R)]; swap

steps.claim: For w ∉ T(R) (so w and w̄ are off the places of X, where μ is unramified, `LValueData.unramified`), the local doubling computation at w (`exists_hasSum_vacuumCoeff_at_place`, k > 1): there are representatives t(γ) of the cosets of the local level at w, supported at w, such that the vacuum coefficients vacuumCoeff(2k, μ·υ^k, t(γ)) sum to ∏_{u∈{w,w̄}}(1 − realZetaCoeff(u)/q_u^k)/(1 − μ⁻¹(ϖ_u)/q_u^k).
steps.lean:
have ⟨_, t, ht, r⟩ :=
    exists_hasSum_vacuumCoeff_at_place X.hasWeight (X.unramified w ?_) (X.unramified _ ?_) hk

steps.claim: T(insert w R) is the disjoint union of T(R) and {w, w̄}, so the product of the local factors splits accordingly.
steps.lean: rw [(?_ : T _ = T R ∪ {w, star w}), prod_union, mul_assoc]

steps.claim: Integrating out the place w: the partial integral at the places of T(insert w R) off D is the sum over the cosets γ of vacuumCoeff(t(γ)) times the partial integral at the places of T(R) off D (`hasSum_partialIntegral_coset`; the datum is the vacuum at w, `IsSharp.vacuum_off`, and the integrand is integrable by (i)); by step 14 this sum is the local factor at {w, w̄} times that partial integral, which gives the value for insert w R.
steps.lean:
refine congrArg _ (.trans congr($(Finset.prod_congr rfl ?_) * _) (((hM ▸ r).mul_right _).unique
    (hasSum_partialIntegral_coset _ t (U.vacuum_off _ _ ?_) i (fun _ ↦ ?_) (SetLike.ext ?k) ht :)))

steps.claim: The local level at the union of the places is the intersection of the local levels (unfolding localLevel).
steps.lean: case' k => simp [localLevel]

steps.claim: The remaining set conditions (w, w̄ are off S; the supports are disjoint; T(insert w R) = T(R) when w ∈ T(R); the representatives lie in the local levels) hold by the definitions of S, D and T and step 7.
steps.lean:
any_goals clear * - e a; grind (gen := 9) [star_star, disjoint_left, mem_localLevel,
    Gf.mem_supportedOn, one_mem]

steps.claim: For the sharp datum of step 8, the partial integral off D equals c₀ times the archimedean integral ∫_x realInner(v, realPairWeil(x, 1)v)·petersson(1, 1·x) (`IsSharp.partialIntegral_eq`); Q is rewritten with it.
steps.lean: erw [(U.partialIntegral_eq _ (y := 1) (by simp) O.detExp 1 1).2] at Q

steps.claim: The theta lift of the constant 1 by the datum v_{P_ξ} ⊗ F equals (that by v_{P_ξ} ⊗ Υ, `AuxPair.lift_auxDatum_eq_lift_modDatum`) the inverse of an index times the form ofAlgForm(paramV(O), 1, trivialLift(X)): the integral over [U(I₁)] of the kernel is a class sum over the level (`Space.integral_quotMeasure_eq_classSum`), by the rationality of theta, the value of theta at the Fock datum (`LValueData.theta_pairWeil_fockDatum`) and the invariance of the kernel form (`LValueData.kernelForm_invariant`).
steps.lean:
have Y := (eq_inv_smul_iff₀ (by simp)).1 ((O.lift_auxDatum_eq_lift_modDatum
    (O.harmonicPoly (highestVector _ O.paramV)) o (by simp)).symm.trans (funext fun _ ↦
    (integral_quotMeasure_eq_classSum (by simpa using! (pairThetaKer ..).theta_rat_mul) (by
    simp_intro _ [X.theta_pairWeil_fockDatum, O]; rfl) _ (X.kernelForm_invariant.2.trans fun _ ↦ by
    simp_intro ..)).trans (congrArg _ ?_) : _ = (_ : ℂ)⁻¹ • ofAlgForm O.paramV 1 X.trivialLift.1))

steps.claim: Rewrite F (the Fock pairing of step 10) in terms of the harmonic polynomial of O: the polynomial toPoly(ξ) of the highest vector is a renaming of harmonicPoly(O)(ξ) (`LValueData.toPoly_eq_rename_harmonicPoly`).
steps.lean:
erw [← map_toPoly, toPoly_eq_rename_harmonicPoly, MvPolynomial.map_rename, show _ = fockPairing ℂ
    _ _ from (congrArg _ (MvPowerSeries.rename_coe ..).symm).trans (jet_rename ⟨_, ?_⟩ rfl _)] at F

steps.claim: The Fock pairing (a jet) is unchanged when the variables of both polynomials are renamed by an injective map (`jet_rename`), so F holds for the harmonic polynomial.
steps.lean:
show _ = fockPairing ℂ
    _ _ from (congrArg _ (MvPowerSeries.rename_coe ..).symm).trans (jet_rename ⟨_, ?_⟩ rfl _)] at F

steps.claim: Unfold the inner product of trivialLift(X) with itself as an index times a Petersson product (`LevelPlaces.LevelForm.inner_eq_petersson`), insert step 20 (Y), and evaluate the real part through the Schur coefficient polynomials (`realPairWeil_schurCoeffPoly`, `LValueData.harmonicPoly_eq_schurCoeffPoly`), the indices of step 3 (G), the numbers of elements of the groups and residue rings involved (`LValueData.card_GL_levelModulus`, `LValueData.card_levelModulus_resRing`), and the factorization of realZetaCoeff at split places (`realZetaCoeff_factor_mul`), in P, Q, F and the goal.
steps.lean:
simp +instances [↓← prod_mul_distrib, ↓X.trivialLift.inner_eq_petersson (stdSpace ..)
    O.isHCParam_paramV, mul_left_comm (conj _), ← Y, O, ↓c, AutChar.L, hM, ← Set.Sum.elim_range,
    realPairWeil_schurCoeffPoly X.isLiftWeight, D, X.card_GL_levelModulus Unit,
    X.card_levelModulus_resRing, Nat.card_pi, X.apart.2, petersson, mul_assoc, ← pow_mul',
    realInner_polyVector, ↓relIndex_levelOf,
    index_pi_univ, auxLevel, HeckeChar.atUnif, mul_pow, realZetaCoeff_factor_mul,
    harmonicPoly_eq_schurCoeffPoly, modDatum, heckeCoeff, G, Nat.card_units,
    Nat.card_congr (Units.mapEquiv (@uniqueRingEquiv Unit (ResField _) ..).toMulEquiv).1] at P Q F ⊢

steps.claim: Substitute F and P into Q and the goal, sum the geometric series ∑_{j<|n|} q^j, and write the Euler products as exponentials (`eulerProd_eq_exp`).
steps.lean:
simp (disch := simp) only [F, P, ← geom_sum_mul, ← one_div, one_sub_div, prod_mul_distrib,
    eulerProd_eq_exp A B, prod_div_distrib, prod_pow] at Q ⊢

steps.claim: C ≠ 0: the total masses of the quotient measures of U(I_n) and U(I₁) are non-zero, and so is the Euler product.
steps.lean: use by simp [measureReal_univ_ne_zero]

steps.claim: After clearing denominators (all non-zero) the asserted identity is Q.
steps.lean: field_simp (disch := norm_cast; simp [ne_of_gt]) at Q ⊢; rw [Q]

steps.claim: The remaining identity between points of the product group holds componentwise.
steps.lean: simp_intro _ [Prod.ext_iff]

steps.claim: The last goal, the value of the algebraic form at the highest vector, follows by unfolding trivialLift(X) and the conjugate highest vector (`star_highestVector`).
steps.lean: simp [O, algFormCoeff_apply, trivialLift, star_highestVector]
